title: Curvy Waifu Villagers
description: Transforms all Minecraft villagers into cute curvy models of girls for a fun and aesthetic twist!
body:
### Age Recommendation: 16+ This resource pack contains stylized character designs and mature visual themes that may not be suitable for younger audiences.
# ✦ Features: ### ⤷ Curvy 3D Villager Models Every villager has been redesigned with smooth, stylized curvy 3D models for a fresh visual experience in your world. ### ⤷ Custom Visual Style Villagers feature a unique reworked aesthetic that enhances their appearance while keeping performance lightweight. ### ⤷ Custom Sound Effects The pack includes custom audio effects for: * Villager interactions * Hit sounds * Ambient reactions > Headphones are recommended for the best experience 😂. # ✦ Requirements ### ⤷ OptiFine / Fabric Support For full compatibility: - **OptiFine users:** Enable *Custom Entity Models (CEM)* in Video Settings → Quality. - **Fabric users:** You need to install these two mods: - **Entity Model Features (EMF)** - **Entity Texture Features (ETF)** Without these, custom models and textures may not display correctly.

❤️ Support the Project

Enjoying this resource pack? Your support helps fund future updates, new features, bug fixes, and the development of more Minecraft projects. Every contribution keeps the work alive and growing.

This button will safely redirect you to my official support page hosted on GitHub Pages, which is 100% safe.

# ✦ Final Notes I hope you enjoy this new visual style for villagers in your Minecraft worlds. If you like the pack, feel free to share it and leave feedback. It really helps improve future updates. Happy crafting!
